fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) hit a mid-year market cap record of KRW 1.2 trillion before declining to the $94 billion range, down from June high of $1,213.18
fields.summary_ko.1: Significant decline in 30-day average trading volume is interpreted as a signal of stock price peak, and investor sentiment has deteriorated amid supply increase concerns despite persistent reports of memory shortage
fields.summary_ko.2: Given the historically high cyclicality of the memory chip industry, current strong profitability is unsustainable and significant stock price decline risk exists when supply increases
